content:
incident-bot: Paging: HelixBank (private/vpc) - auth failures observed on dedicated pool (severity: P1). Recent automated cert rotation flagged. Please acknowledge if oncall.

oncall-ryan: acked. I'm taking primary. seeing a flurry of 401s and TLS handshakes failing from the pool in us-east-1.

sara-pm: customer reporting transaction latency and auth errors, some retries, high error rate for payment endpoints. Impacting a subset of producing tenants (HelixBank only).

julia-cse: FYI customer side reports connection resets and "remote error: tls: bad certificate" in their logs. They said rotation was scheduled 10:10 UTC and errors started ~10:15.

infra-nikhil: quick triage: querying logs on the dedicated gateway shows OIDC validation failures: "token verification failed: kid not found" for issuer https://idp.helixbank.example. Also seeing mTLS "alert handshake failure" from the edge sidecar.

devops-amy: copying relevant tail from the pool controller logs: ```
2026-03-12T10:16:02Z pool-helix-dp-3 auth.go:214 Error: oidc: token kid mismatch (token kid 0x9f..., known keys: [0x7a,0x8b])
2026-03-12T10:16:04Z sidecar tls.go:87 WARN: mTLS handshake failed: remote: unknown ca
```

oncall-ryan: hypothesis: HelixBank rotated their IdP signing key and CA at the same time. Our automated cert sync pushed a new leaf cert to the customer sidecar, but the pool sidecars did not pick up the updated CA bundle. Token verification uses JWKS kid which changed. Need to confirm whether our JWKS cache was invalidated.

julia-cse: customer confirms they rotated both signing key and mTLS CA this morning. They thought our agent would fetch the new JWKS automatically.

infra-nikhil: checking JWKS fetch timeline: our fetcher had a 10m jitter; last successful fetch for issuer was 10:05, then new keys at 10:12. Fetch retry logs show rate-limited backoff; a recent deploy changed error handling so fetch failure didn't trigger immediate retry. This is a regression.

oncall-ryan: immediate mitigation plan: 1) create a temporary JWKS override for HelixBank on the auth proxy to include both old and new keys; 2) allow a short maintenance window to accept bearer tokens with either kid; 3) restart sidecar on pool nodes in small batches to pick up new CA bundle.

sara-pm: customer asked for timeframe; what's ETA for 1-3?

devops-amy: I can push the JWKS override now. Command: ```rbctl auth jwks override set --tenant helixbank --jwks-file /tmp/helix-jwks.json --ttl 60m``` Applying in 2m.

oncall-ryan: amy go ahead. I'll coordinate node restarts. We'll roll 1 pod per AZ every 2 minutes to avoid full pool outage.

incident-bot: action logged: jwks-override-applied by devops-amy at 1830123590.

customer-helixops: thanks, we can hold traffic if you want to drain for restarts. prefer minimal downtime.

oncall-ryan: we'll drain connections gracefully. plan: mark target nodes cordon, drain, restart sidecar, uncordon. Monitoring: successful TLS handshake counts and 2xx rates.

infra-nikhil: while doing this, I'm reverting the fetch-backoff regression in a hotfix patch (branch: fix/jwks-retry) so future JWKS updates won't be missed. Rolling a canary to 1 node now.

julia-cse: customer-facing update: "We're applying a short maintenance to fix auth cert sync. A subset of requests may see brief retries; we're targeting full restore within 30 minutes." sent at 10:35 UTC.

oncall-ryan: post-override telemetry: error rate for HelixBank auth requests dropped 70% within 90s. mTLS handshake failures reduced but still seeing intermittent failures on two nodes.

devops-amy: node restart batch 1 complete (az-a). sidecars reloaded with new CA bundle. curl test passing: ```curl -v --cert client.pem --key client.key https://pool-helix-us-east1.example/health``` shows HTTP/2 200.

oncall-ryan: batch 2 in progress. draining az-b now.

customer-helixops: we see a lot of 200s coming through, thank you. still seeing small number of errors from legacy clients.

infra-nikhil: legacy clients are failing because they didn't trust the new CA chain; adding a short-lived compatibility policy to accept legacy cert chain during maintenance window. applied to helixbank pool route. ```
route:
  tenant: helixbank
  tls:
    accept_legacy_chain: true
    legacy_ttl: 15m
```

julia-cse: note added to postmortem: compatibility policy should always require explicit opt-in from customer side. We'll clarify docs.

oncall-ryan: final status check: all pool nodes restarted, all sidecars report current CA bundle timestamp 2026-03-12T10:12:20Z. JWKS override will expire in 55m; fetcher hotfix deployed to all fetcher pods so next JWKS rotation should be automatic.

devops-amy: removing temporary override in 45m as part of cleanup plan.

customer-helixops: confirmed end-to-end test suite green. Reducing priority on our side. appreciated quick response.

oncall-ryan: marking incident as mitigated for HelixBank. will hand off to infra-nikhil for follow-up and RCA. Paging: handoff to infra for root cause and postmortem.

incident-bot: escalation: oncall-ryan -> infra-nikhil at 1830123800.

infra-nikhil: assigned for RCA. immediate root cause notes: JWKS fetch backoff regression + simultaneous rotation of signing key and mTLS CA by customer. Next steps: postmortem, test harness for JWKS rotations, and a runbook update for cert rotation (including a recommended window and handshake tests).

julia-cse: I'll file the postmortem and loop in support and customer success.

sara-pm: action items captured: - hotfix fetcher retry (deployed) - postmortem + runbook - add metrics/alert for JWKS staleness - improve docs for customers on coordinated rotations

oncall-ryan: closing thread from on-call; keep monitoring for 2 hours then archive. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
